name: itecs-ncentral-rest
description: Read-only self-hosted N-central REST inventory with automatic ITECS Automation Vault setup.

interface.longDescription: Native read-only customer/device inventory for self-hosted N-central. Automatically uses the ITECS Automation Vault API reader through op-itecs. Existing SSO is unchanged; custom per-user configurations are preserved.
defaultPrompt: Look up customers and devices on our self-hosted N-central server.
